words.english_meaning: To share or exchange information, ideas, or feelings with others.
words.gujarati_meaning: માહિતી, વિચારો અથવા ભાવનાઓ બીજા સાથે શેર કરવી અથવા આપ-લે કરવી.
words.usage_note: Used in professional contexts to stress clarity and effectiveness of information exchange.
words.memory_tip: 'communicate' = com + municate → 'common' + 'connect' → બધાને જોડવું.
examples: She communicates very clearly with her team.
He failed to communicate the deadline properly.
We need to communicate the changes to all departments.
It is important to communicate professionally via email.

words.english_meaning: Written communication, especially letters or emails exchanged between people or organizations.
words.gujarati_meaning: પત્ર અથવા ઈ-મેઇલ દ્વારા થતો સત્તાવાર સંવાદ.
words.usage_note: Often refers to formal written exchange in business or legal settings.
words.memory_tip: 'correspond' = co + respond → સાથે જવાબ આપવો → correspondence = letter exchange.
examples: All official correspondence must be filed.
She handles the correspondence with overseas clients.
The lawyer reviewed the correspondence before the trial.
Business correspondence should always be polite and professional.

words.english_meaning: A short official written message sent within an organization.
words.gujarati_meaning: સંસ્થામાં આંતરિક રીતે મોકલવામાં આવતો ટૂંકો સત્તાવાર સંદેશ.
words.usage_note: Short for 'memorandum'; commonly used in offices for quick internal announcements.
words.memory_tip: 'memo' = memory + note → યાદ અપાવવા માટેની ચિઠ્ઠી.
examples: The manager sent a memo about the new policy.
Please circulate this memo to all staff.
I received a memo regarding tomorrow's meeting.
Write a memo to the HR department about the holiday schedule.

words.english_meaning: A formal plan or suggestion put forward for consideration.
words.gujarati_meaning: વિચારણા માટે રજૂ કરવામાં આવેલ ઔપચારિક યોજના અથવા સૂચન.
words.usage_note: A 'proposal' is more formal than a suggestion and usually includes supporting details.
words.memory_tip: 'proposal' = pro + pose → 'આગળ' + 'મૂકવું' → proposal = આગળ મૂકવામાં આવેલ વિચાર.
examples: She submitted a proposal for the new project.
The board approved the business proposal.
His proposal was rejected due to budget constraints.
We need a detailed proposal before moving forward.

words.english_meaning: A meeting where information or instructions are given to a group.
words.gujarati_meaning: જૂથને માહિતી અથવા સૂચનાઓ આપવામાં આવે તેવી બેઠક.
words.usage_note: Often used in military, government, or corporate settings before an event or action.
words.memory_tip: 'brief' = ટૂંક → briefing = ટૂંકી માહિતી આપવી.
examples: The team had a briefing before the client visit.
The manager conducted a morning briefing.
She gave a briefing on the new safety procedures.
Attend the media briefing at 10 AM.

words.english_meaning: Information given to someone about their performance or work to help them improve.
words.gujarati_meaning: કોઈ વ્યક્તિને તેના કામ અથવા પ્રદર્શન વિશે આપવામાં આવેલ સૂચન અથવા અભિપ્રાય.
words.usage_note: 'Constructive feedback' is positive and helpful; 'negative feedback' points out faults.
words.memory_tip: 'feed' + 'back' → પાછું ખવડાવવું → feedback = response back to improve.
examples: The manager gave positive feedback on the report.
Please share your feedback after the session.
Constructive feedback helps employees grow.
She was nervous about receiving feedback on her presentation.

words.english_meaning: A list of topics or items to be discussed or acted upon.
words.gujarati_meaning: ચર્ચા અથવા કાર્ય માટેની બાબતોની યાદી.
words.usage_note: Also used figuratively: 'What's your agenda?' means what are your hidden motives.
words.memory_tip: 'agenda' = 'a genda' → Latin: 'things to be done' → કરવાની વાતોની યાદી.
examples: The agenda for today's meeting includes budget review.
She set the agenda before the conference.
There was no hidden agenda in his proposal.
The chairman distributed the agenda in advance.

words.english_meaning: To discuss something in order to reach an agreement.
words.gujarati_meaning: કોઈ બાબત પર સહમત થવા માટે ચર્ચા કરવી.
words.usage_note: Negotiation requires compromise from both sides.
words.memory_tip: 'negotiate' = ne + go + tiate → 'ના' + 'જાઓ' → ના-ના કરીને agreement → negotiate.
examples: They negotiated the contract terms for three hours.
She is skilled at negotiating salary packages.
Both companies agreed to negotiate a new deal.
The union and management negotiated a fair wage increase.

words.english_meaning: A formal talk or display of information to an audience.
words.gujarati_meaning: પ્રેક્ષકો સમક્ષ માહિતી રજૂ કરવાની ઔપચારિક રીત.
words.usage_note: Can be oral, visual, or both; often includes slides in a corporate setting.
words.memory_tip: 'present' = રજૂ કરવું → presentation = રજૂઆત.
examples: He gave an impressive presentation on market trends.
She prepared slides for her presentation.
The presentation lasted forty-five minutes.
Our team's presentation won the client's approval.

words.english_meaning: A formal document that presents findings, information, or analysis.
words.gujarati_meaning: તારણો, માહિતી અથવા વિશ્લેષણ રજૂ કરતો ઔપચારિક દસ્તાવેજ.
words.usage_note: Reports can be written or verbal; written reports are more common in offices.
words.memory_tip: 'report' = re + port → 'ફરી' + 'લઈ જવું' → report = information carried back.
examples: The quarterly report was submitted on time.
She wrote a detailed report on the incident.
He reported the findings to the board.
The annual report showed strong financial growth.

words.english_meaning: The latest time or date by which something must be completed.
words.gujarati_meaning: કોઈ કામ પૂર્ણ કરવા માટેની છેલ્લી તારીખ અથવા સમય.
words.usage_note: Missing a deadline in professional settings can have serious consequences.
words.memory_tip: 'deadline' = dead + line → 'dead' = ખતમ → deadline = ખતમ થવાની line = છેલ્લો સમય.
examples: We must meet the project deadline by Friday.
She always delivers her work before the deadline.
The team missed the deadline due to technical issues.
Set realistic deadlines to avoid burnout.

words.english_meaning: To make something clearer and easier to understand.
words.gujarati_meaning: કોઈ બાબત વધુ સ્પષ્ટ અને સમજવા સરળ બનાવવી.
words.usage_note: Often used to politely request more information: 'Can you clarify that?'
words.memory_tip: 'clarify' = clarity + fy → clarity = સ્પષ્ટતા → clarify = સ્પષ્ટ કરવું.
examples: Can you clarify what you mean by that?
She clarified the instructions for the new staff.
Please clarify your role in the project.
He asked for a moment to clarify his thoughts.

words.english_meaning: To give a brief statement of the main points of something.
words.gujarati_meaning: કોઈ બાબતના મુખ્ય મુદ્દા ટૂંકમાં રજૂ કરવા.
words.usage_note: Often used at the end of meetings or reports to review main points.
words.memory_tip: 'summarize' = summary + ize → summary = સારાંશ → summarize = સારાંશ આપવો.
examples: Can you summarize the main points of the meeting?
She summarized the report in three bullet points.
He summarized the client's concerns for the team.
Please summarize the discussion in the minutes.

words.english_meaning: A formal request for information or an investigation into something.
words.gujarati_meaning: માહિતી માટે ઔપચારિક વિનંતી અથવા કોઈ બાબત અંગેની તપાસ.
words.usage_note: In British English often spelled 'enquiry'; 'inquiry' is more common in American English.
words.memory_tip: 'inquire' = in + quire → 'અંદર' + 'પૂછવું' → inquiry = formal question.
examples: She made an inquiry about the job opening.
All customer inquiries must be answered within 24 hours.
The company launched a formal inquiry into the incident.
He sent an email inquiry to the supplier.

words.english_meaning: To confirm receipt of something or recognize someone's contribution.
words.gujarati_meaning: કોઈ વસ્તુ મળ્યાની પુષ્ટિ કરવી અથવા કોઈ વ્યક્તિના યોગદાનને સ્વીકારવું.
words.usage_note: In emails: 'I acknowledge receipt of your message' confirms you received it.
words.memory_tip: 'acknowledge' = ac + know + ledge → 'know' = જાણવું → acknowledge = જાણ્યાનો સ્વીકાર.
examples: Please acknowledge receipt of this email.
The manager acknowledged the team's hard work.
She acknowledged the mistake and corrected it.
He acknowledged the client's concerns during the meeting.

words.english_meaning: The act of assigning responsibility or authority to another person.
words.gujarati_meaning: બીજ વ્યક્તિને જવાબદારી અથવা અધિકાર સોંપવાની ક્રિયા.
words.usage_note: Good managers use delegation to empower their teams and manage time effectively.
words.memory_tip: 'delegate' = de + legate → legate = 'ambassador' → delegation = sending someone else to act.
examples: Effective delegation improves team productivity.
She used delegation to manage her heavy workload.
The CEO relied on delegation to run the company.
Poor delegation leads to confusion in responsibilities.

words.english_meaning: Intended to be kept secret and not shared with others.
words.gujarati_meaning: ગુપ્ત રાખવા માટે અભિપ્રેત; જે અન્ય સાથે શેર ન કરવી.
words.usage_note: Documents marked 'confidential' should not be shared outside the organization.
words.memory_tip: 'confidential' = confidence + ial → confidence = વિશ્વાસ → confidential = વિશ્વાસઘાત ન કરો.
examples: The report is strictly confidential.
All employee records are kept confidential.
Do not share confidential information with third parties.
She signed a confidential agreement before starting the project.

words.english_meaning: A small, enclosed workspace within a larger open office area.
words.gujarati_meaning: મોટા ઓફિસ વિસ્તારની અંદર નાની, અર્ધ-ઘેરાયેલ કામ કરવાની જગ્યા.
words.usage_note: Common in large corporate offices; gives semi-privacy in an open layout.
words.memory_tip: 'cubicle' = cube + icle → cube = ઘન → cubicle = cube જેવી નાની જગ્યા.
examples: She decorated her cubicle with family photos.
He worked in a cubicle on the third floor.
The open office replaced cubicles with shared desks.
A cubicle provides some privacy in a large office.

words.english_meaning: A desk or area equipped with a computer and accessories for one person to work.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક વ્યક્તિ માટે કમ્પ્યૂટર અને સાધનો સાથે સજ્જ ડેસ્ક અથવા કાર્ય-વિસ્તાર.
words.usage_note: In IT, a workstation can also refer to a powerful desktop computer.
words.memory_tip: 'workstation' = work + station → work = કામ + station = સ્ટૉપ → workstation = કામ કરવાની જગ્યા.
examples: Each employee has their own workstation.
He set up a new workstation for the intern.
The workstation was equipped with dual monitors.
An ergonomic workstation reduces back pain.

words.english_meaning: The area at the entrance of an office where visitors are greeted.
words.gujarati_meaning: ઑફિસના પ્રવેશ પર આવેલ વિસ્તાર જ્યાં મુલાકાતીઓનું સ્વાગત થાય છે.
words.usage_note: A 'receptionist' works at the reception and manages visitors and calls.
words.memory_tip: 'reception' = receive + tion → receive = સ્વીકારવું → reception = સ્વાગત-ક્ષેત્ર.
examples: Please wait at the reception until someone comes.
The receptionist greeted all visitors warmly.
All guests must sign in at the reception desk.
The reception area was redesigned to look more professional.

words.english_meaning: A room in an office used for meetings and group discussions.
words.gujarati_meaning: ઑફિસમાં બેઠકો અને ગ્રૂપ ચર્ચા માટે ઉપયોગમાં લેવાતો ઓરડો.
words.usage_note: Usually equipped with a large table, chairs, projector, and whiteboard.
words.memory_tip: 'conference' = together + talk → conference room = સૌ સાથે મળીને વાત કરે ત્યાં.
examples: Book the conference room for the 3 PM meeting.
The conference room seats up to twenty people.
She presented her findings in the conference room.
The conference room is equipped with video call facilities.

words.english_meaning: Writing and office materials such as pens, paper, and envelopes.
words.gujarati_meaning: કલમ, કાગળ, કવર જેવી લેખન અને ઑફિસ સામગ્રી.
words.usage_note: Do not confuse with 'stationary' (not moving); stationery = office supplies.
words.memory_tip: 'stationery' → remember 'e' for 'envelope' → stationery = envelope + writing things.
examples: The office stationery was ordered last week.
She picked up stationery from the supply room.
We need to restock the stationery cabinet.
Branded stationery gives a professional impression.

words.english_meaning: A machine that produces printed copies of digital documents.
words.gujarati_meaning: ડિજિટલ દસ્તાવેજોની છાપેલ નકલ બનાવતું ઉપકરણ.
words.usage_note: Common office issue: 'printer jam' means paper is stuck inside the printer.
words.memory_tip: 'printer' = print + er → print = છાપવું → printer = છાપનાર મશીન.
examples: The printer ran out of ink during the presentation.
Please print the report on the office printer.
The printer is on the second floor near the kitchen.
He fixed the printer jam before the meeting.

words.english_meaning: A white surface used for writing with markers during meetings or training.
words.gujarati_meaning: બેઠક અથવા તાલીમ દરમિયાન માર્કરથી લખવા માટે ઉપયોગમાં લેવાતી સફેદ સપાટી.
words.usage_note: Used widely in brainstorming sessions and training rooms.
words.memory_tip: 'whiteboard' = white + board → સફેદ + ફળિયું → whiteboard = white writing board.
examples: She drew the process diagram on the whiteboard.
The trainer used the whiteboard to explain concepts.
Erase the whiteboard before the next meeting.
An interactive whiteboard is connected to the computer.

words.english_meaning: A device that projects images or slides onto a screen.
words.gujarati_meaning: સ્ક્રીન પર ચિત્રો અથવા સ્લાઇડ્સ દર્શાવતું ઉપકરણ.
words.usage_note: Common in boardrooms and classrooms for displaying presentations.
words.memory_tip: 'projector' = project + or → project = ફેંકવું → projector = image ફેંકે.
examples: Connect the laptop to the projector before the meeting.
The projector bulb needs to be replaced.
She used the projector to display the sales charts.
Make sure the projector is working before the presentation.

words.english_meaning: A small room or area in an office where food, drinks, and kitchen supplies are kept.
words.gujarati_meaning: ઑફિસમાં ખોરાક, પીણાં અને રસોઈ-સામગ્રી રાખવા માટેનો નાનો ઓરડો.
words.usage_note: Often a social space where colleagues gather during breaks.
words.memory_tip: 'pantry' = pan + try → pan = વાસણ → pantry = pan and food store.
examples: She had her coffee break in the office pantry.
The pantry was stocked with snacks and beverages.
Please keep the pantry clean after use.
They held a quick discussion in the pantry.

words.english_meaning: A piece of furniture with drawers for storing files and documents.
words.gujarati_meaning: ફાઇલો અને દસ્તાવેજો સંગ્રહ કરવા માટે ખાના ધરાવતો ફર્નિચરનો ટુકડો.
words.usage_note: Important documents are often kept in locked filing cabinets for security.
words.memory_tip: 'filing' = file + ing → file = ફાઇલ → filing cabinet = ફાઇલ સ્ટોર.
examples: The contract is in the filing cabinet.
She organized all documents into the filing cabinet.
Lock the filing cabinet before leaving the office.
The filing cabinet is overflowing with old records.

words.english_meaning: Designed for comfort and efficiency in the working environment.
words.gujarati_meaning: કામ કરવાના વાતાવરણમાં આરામ અને કાર્યક્ષમતા માટે ડિઝાઇન કરેલ.
words.usage_note: Ergonomic design helps prevent repetitive strain injuries and back pain.
words.memory_tip: 'ergonomic' = ergo (work) + nomic (law) → worklaw → work comfort design.
examples: She invested in an ergonomic chair to avoid back pain.
The company provided ergonomic keyboards to all staff.
An ergonomic setup increases productivity.
Ergonomic furniture is essential in modern offices.

words.english_meaning: A board on a wall where notices and announcements are posted.
words.gujarati_meaning: દિવાલ પર લગાડેલ બૉર્ડ જ્યાં નોટિસ અને જાહેરાતો લગાડવામાં આવે છે.
words.usage_note: Used in offices, schools, and communities to share general information.
words.memory_tip: 'bulletin' = bullet + in → bulletin board = notices 'fired' at the public.
examples: She pinned the schedule to the bulletin board.
Check the bulletin board for the latest announcements.
The event notice was posted on the bulletin board.
They used the bulletin board to share motivational quotes.

words.english_meaning: Describing an office layout with few or no walls, encouraging collaboration.
words.gujarati_meaning: ઑફિસ ડિઝાઇન જ્યાં ઓછી અથવા ન જ ઓ walls હોય, teamwork ને પ્રોત્સાહ આપે.
words.usage_note: Open-plan offices encourage collaboration but can reduce individual privacy.
words.memory_tip: 'open-plan' = open + plan → ખુલ્લી + ગોઠવણ → open-plan = ખુલ્લી ઑફિસ.
examples: The company moved to an open-plan office to boost teamwork.
Many employees prefer private offices over open-plan layouts.
The open-plan design allows easy communication.
An open-plan office reduces noise barriers.

words.english_meaning: A system where employees use any available desk rather than having a fixed one.
words.gujarati_meaning: એ પ્રણાલી જ્યાં કર્મચારીઓ ગમે ત્યારે ઉપલબ્ધ ડેસ્ક ઉપયોગ કરે, નિશ્ચિત ડેસ્ક ન હોય.
words.usage_note: Common in companies with hybrid work models where not everyone is in the office every day.
words.memory_tip: 'hot-desking' = hot + desk → 'hot' = popular/in demand → grab any available desk.
examples: The company introduced hot-desking to save space.
Hot-desking requires employees to clear their desk daily.
She didn't enjoy hot-desking as she missed her own space.
Hot-desking is common in companies with remote-first policies.

words.english_meaning: A private internal network used within an organization for sharing information.
words.gujarati_meaning: સંસ્થામાં આંતરિક રીતે માહિતી શેર કરવા માટે ઉપયોગમાં લેવાતું ખાનગી નેટવર્ક.
words.usage_note: Unlike the internet, the intranet is accessible only to employees of the organization.
words.memory_tip: 'intranet' = intra (inside) + net → inside network → ઑફિસ અંદરનું internet.
examples: All policies are available on the company intranet.
Log in to the intranet to access HR forms.
The intranet was updated with the new office guidelines.
She posted the newsletter on the intranet.

words.english_meaning: A room in an office where stationery and other supplies are stored.
words.gujarati_meaning: ઑફિસ સ્ટેશનરી અને અન્ય સામગ્રી સ્ટોર કરવા માટેનો ઓરડો.
words.usage_note: Employees usually sign out items taken from the supply room to manage inventory.
words.memory_tip: 'supply room' = supply + room → supply = સામગ્રી → supply room = સામગ્રી ઓરડો.
examples: Get extra pens from the supply room.
The supply room is locked after 6 PM.
She restocked the supply room with printer paper.
All office supplies are kept in the supply room.

words.english_meaning: An ID card worn by employees to identify themselves and access office areas.
words.gujarati_meaning: કર્મચારીઓ દ્વારા ઓળખ અને ઑફિસ વિસ્તારોમાં પ્રવેશ માટે પહેરવામાં આવતું ID કાર્ડ.
words.usage_note: In secure offices, employees swipe their badge to enter restricted areas.
words.memory_tip: 'badge' = ઓળખ-ચિહ્ન → badge = your identity at work.
examples: Always wear your badge while in the office.
She forgot her badge and couldn't enter the building.
Swipe your badge at the entrance gate.
The security guard checked everyone's badge.

words.english_meaning: The official written record of what was discussed and decided in a meeting.
words.gujarati_meaning: બેઠકમાં શું ચર્ચ્યું અને શું નક્કી થ્યું તેનો સત્તાવાર લેખિત રેકૉર્ડ.
words.usage_note: Minutes are usually written by a secretary or designated note-taker.
words.memory_tip: 'minutes' = minute + s → small notes → meeting ની ટૂંકી નોંધ.
examples: She was asked to take the minutes at the board meeting.
The minutes were circulated to all attendees.

The minutes were approved at the start of the meeting.

words.english_meaning: The minimum number of members required to be present to make a meeting valid.
words.gujarati_meaning: બેઠકને માન્ય ઠરાવવા માટે ઉપસ્થિત હોવા જ જોઈએ તેવા ન્યૂ nतम સભ્યોની સંખ્યા.
words.usage_note: If a quorum is not reached, the meeting cannot officially proceed.
words.memory_tip: 'quorum' = Latin 'of whom' → quorum = 'of whom enough must be present'.
examples: The meeting was postponed because there was no quorum.
A quorum of ten members is required for voting.
We need to confirm the quorum before starting.
The chairperson declared that the quorum was met.

words.english_meaning: The person who leads or presides over a meeting.
words.gujarati_meaning: બેઠકની અધ્યક્ષતા કરનાર વ્યક્તિ.
words.usage_note: Gender-neutral term replacing 'chairman'; 'chair' is also widely used.
words.memory_tip: 'chairperson' = chair + person → chair = ખુરશી → chairperson = ખુરશી વળો = leader.
examples: The chairperson opened the meeting at 9 AM.
She was elected chairperson of the committee.
The chairperson called for a vote on the proposal.
The chairperson ensured all voices were heard.

words.english_meaning: Tasks or decisions assigned to individuals at the end of a meeting.
words.gujarati_meaning: બેઠકના અંતે વ્યક્તિઓને સોંપવામાં આવેલ કાર્ય અથવા નિર્ણય.
words.usage_note: Action points ensure accountability; each item should have an owner and a deadline.
words.memory_tip: 'action points' = action + points → action = ક્રિયા → action points = કામ કરવાની યાદી.
examples: The meeting ended with a list of action points.
She followed up on all action points from last week.
Each action point was assigned to a team member.
Review the action points before the next meeting.

words.english_meaning: To generate many ideas spontaneously in a group discussion.
words.gujarati_meaning: ગ્રૂપ ચર્ચામાં સ્વ-ચ-સ્ફૂર્ત ઘણા વિચારો ઉત્પન્ન કરવા.
words.usage_note: In brainstorming, no idea is rejected initially; all suggestions are welcome.
words.memory_tip: 'brainstorm' = brain + storm → brain = મગજ + storm = તોફान → ideas ની વંટોળ.
examples: Let's brainstorm ideas for the new marketing campaign.
The team held a brainstorming session on Friday.
They brainstormed solutions to the customer complaint.
Brainstorming helps uncover creative approaches.

words.english_meaning: To make a process or meeting easier to run or manage.
words.gujarati_meaning: કોઈ પ્રક્રિયા અથવા બેઠક સરળ અને સ્ઝ્ = manage કરવા-લાયક બનાવવી.
words.usage_note: A facilitator guides a group discussion without leading it from a position of authority.
words.memory_tip: 'facilitate' = facil (easy) + itate → make easy → facilitate = સરળ બનાવવું.
examples: She was asked to facilitate the workshop.
A neutral person should facilitate the negotiation.
He facilitated the discussion between the two departments.
Good facilitators keep meetings on track.

words.english_meaning: To formally bring a meeting to an end or to postpone it to another time.
words.gujarati_meaning: બેઠક ઔપચારિક રીતે સ્થગિત કરવી અથવા બીજા સમય પર ટ�ળવી.
words.usage_note: The chairperson typically adjourns a meeting after all agenda items are covered.

examples: The meeting was adjourned at 5 PM.
The chairperson adjourned the session due to lack of quorum.
We will adjourn and meet again next Monday.
The committee adjourned after three hours of discussion.

words.english_meaning: General agreement among all members of a group.
words.gujarati_meaning: ગ્રૂ pના તમામ સભ્ysomena ની સામાન્ય સહમtiv.
words.usage_note: Consensus means everyone agrees; it is different from a majority vote.
words.memory_tip: 'consensus' = con (together) + sensus (feeling) → same feeling together → consensus = agreement.
examples: The team reached a consensus on the new strategy.
Consensus was difficult to achieve on the budget cut.
The decision was made by consensus, not by vote.
Building consensus takes time but ensures commitment.

words.english_meaning: A pad of large paper on a stand used to display information during meetings.
words.gujarati_meaning: Stands ઉ ola pe mota kagaznun pad jo meeting ma mahiti dakahvava vaperay.
words.usage_note: Used in training sessions and workshops for interactive group activities.
words.memory_tip: 'flipchart' = flip + chart → flip = ઊ tn → flipchart = ઊ tn chart.
examples: She wrote the key points on the flipchart.
The trainer used a flipchart instead of a projector.
Notes from the flipchart were photographed after the session.
Bring a flipchart to the training room.

words.english_meaning: A formal decision made by a group, committee, or meeting.
words.gujarati_meaning: ગ્રૂp, સoalmity અoalthવl meeting દ્વারા કloylayel aut formal nIrnay.

The conflict was resolved with a mutual resolution.
She drafted the resolution for the shareholders' meeting.

words.english_meaning: A single topic or point listed for discussion on a meeting agenda.
words.gujarati_meaning: meeting agendama charchava mate nondhelay ek mukko athava vishay.
words.usage_note: Each agenda item should have an estimated time allocated for discussion.
words.memory_tip: 'agenda item' = agenda + item → agenda = list → agenda item = yadima ek vastu.

Each agenda item was given fifteen minutes.
The agenda item on staffing was deferred to next week.

words.english_meaning: An action taken after a meeting or event to check on progress or complete a task.

words.usage_note: Always send a follow-up email after an important meeting to confirm decisions.
words.memory_tip: 'follow-up' = follow + up → follow = pichu → follow-up = pichu follow karvanu.

A follow-up meeting was scheduled for next Tuesday.
He completed all follow-up tasks within the day.
Don't forget the follow-up after the presentation.

words.english_meaning: A period of time after a presentation when the audience can ask questions.
words.gujarati_meaning: presentation baad no time period jyare audience prashno puchhi shake.
words.usage_note: Q&A stands for Questions and Answers; often held at the end of a talk or webinar.

The Q&A session lasted thirty minutes.

words.english_meaning: A person who manages the discussion in a meeting or debate.
words.gujarati_meaning: meeting athava charcha na sanchaalan karnaar vayakti.
words.usage_note: In online meetings, a moderator controls who speaks and manages technical issues.
words.memory_tip: 'moderator' = moderate + or → moderate = saamany → moderator = jo saamanytaa rakhey.

The online meeting had a dedicated moderator.
A good moderator ensures balanced participation.

words.english_meaning: A set of slides used in a presentation, typically made in PowerPoint or similar software.
words.gujarati_meaning: PowerPoint jeva software ma banel slides no set, jo presentation ma vaperay.
words.usage_note: 'Slide deck' is the informal name for a set of presentation slides.
words.memory_tip: 'slide deck' = slide + deck → deck = set → slide deck = slides no set.

words.english_meaning: A meeting conducted online using video or audio conferencing tools.

words.english_meaning: A meeting conducted by telephone or video between people in different locations.

words.english_meaning: The process of finding and hiring new employees for a company.

words.english_meaning: A formal assessment of an employee's performance, usually done annually.

words.english_meaning: An advancement to a higher position or rank within an organization.

Prioritizing helps meet deadlines efficiently.

words.english_meaning: A point in a process where the flow is slowed or blocked, causing delays.

words.gujarati_meaning: Nakkhi thayel samay tak na thayel athava na bharelo.
words.usage_note: An overdue task needs immediate attention; an overdue payment can attract penalties.
words.memory_tip: 'overdue' = over + due → 'vadhi gayel' + 'baaki' → overdue = mudat vadhi gai chhe.
examples: The payment is two weeks overdue.
He submitted the overdue report with an apology.
Several tasks are overdue and need immediate attention.
Avoid overdue invoices by setting payment reminders.

words.english_meaning: Specific goals or results that employees or teams are expected to achieve.
words.gujarati_meaning: Karmachario athava team ne padhava na nakkhi karyel lakshya ya parinaam.
words.usage_note: Targets should be SMART: Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, and Time-bound.
words.memory_tip: 'target' = lakshya → target = teer kya lagne chhe teva → goal.
examples: She exceeded her sales targets for the quarter.
The team set ambitious targets for the new year.
Failing to meet targets can affect your appraisal.
Targets should be realistic and clearly communicated.

words.english_meaning: A schedule showing when each employee is expected to work.
words.gujarati_meaning: Kya karmachari kyare kaam karshe te darshavtu schedule.
words.usage_note: In shift-based jobs, a roster tells employees their working hours for the week or month.
words.memory_tip: 'roster' = ro + ster → rotating + star → fera badlati duty → roster = duty schedule.
examples: The roster for next month has been posted.
She checked the roster before planning her holiday.
Managers prepare the roster every Sunday.
The roster was updated to cover for the absent staff.

words.english_meaning: The amount of time taken to complete a task or process from start to finish.
words.gujarati_meaning: Koi kaam ya prakriya shurua thi puri thava sudhi nu samay praman.
words.usage_note: Clients often specify a turnaround time when placing orders or requests.
words.memory_tip: 'turnaround' = turn + around → farvanu → turnaround time = faravano samay.
examples: The turnaround time for this order is 48 hours.
Clients expect a fast turnaround time on quotes.
Automating the process reduced turnaround time.
The agency guaranteed a 24-hour turnaround time.

words.english_meaning: A person you work with, especially in a professional or office environment.
words.gujarati_meaning: Saath kaam kartu vayakti, khaaskarake vayavsayik athava office vatavaranma.
words.usage_note: 'Colleague' implies a professional relationship; 'friend' is more personal.
words.memory_tip: 'colleague' = col + league → league = sangh → colleague = same sangh ma kaam karnaar.
examples: She discussed the project with her colleagues.
He helped a struggling colleague meet the deadline.
My colleague gave me useful advice on the report.
Always treat your colleagues with respect.

words.english_meaning: An experienced person who guides and advises someone less experienced.
words.gujarati_meaning: Anubhavi vayakti jo ochha anubhavi ne margdarshan ane salah aape.
words.usage_note: A mentor provides career guidance, not just technical knowledge.
words.memory_tip: 'mentor' = man + tor → 'experience + lead' → mentor = anubhav thi margdarshan.
examples: She found a mentor who helped her navigate corporate politics.
He served as a mentor to junior employees.
A good mentor accelerates career growth.
The company runs a formal mentorship program.

words.english_meaning: A system in which people are ranked according to their authority or status.
words.gujarati_meaning: Evi vyavastha jema vyaktionu sarjni unchi athava nichi sthiti pramane vikraman karaya.
words.usage_note: In a flat hierarchy, fewer levels exist and communication is more direct.
words.memory_tip: 'hierarchy' = higher + archy → hierarchy = oochu pad → ranking system.
examples: The company has a strict hierarchy with five management levels.
She struggled to navigate the corporate hierarchy.
A flat hierarchy promotes open communication.
Promotions move employees up the hierarchy.

words.english_meaning: Building professional relationships that can help advance a career.
words.gujarati_meaning: Career ne aage vadharva mate vayavsayik sambandho banaavvu.
words.usage_note: Networking on LinkedIn and at industry events opens career opportunities.
words.memory_tip: 'networking' = net + work → net = jaal → networking = sambandho nu jaal banavu.
examples: She attended a networking event to meet industry leaders.
Networking helped him find his current job.
LinkedIn is a powerful tool for professional networking.
Networking skills are essential for career growth.

words.english_meaning: The process of resolving a disagreement or dispute between people.
words.gujarati_meaning: Lokono nikhay athava vivad udi karvani prakriya.
words.usage_note: Conflict resolution skills include active listening, empathy, and compromise.
words.memory_tip: 'conflict resolution' = jhagdo + udi karvo → conflict resolution = jhagda no anto.
examples: The HR team was trained in conflict resolution.
Effective conflict resolution improves team morale.
She used conflict resolution techniques to settle the dispute.
Conflict resolution should be handled promptly.

words.english_meaning: A feeling of trust, cooperation, and support among team members.
words.gujarati_meaning: Team na sadasyo vacche vishvaas, sahyog ane takarano bhaav.
words.usage_note: Team-building activities help boost team spirit and improve workplace relationships.
words.memory_tip: 'team spirit' = team + spirit → team = juth + spirit = bhaav → team spirit = milelu bhaav.
examples: The manager organised activities to build team spirit.
High team spirit improves overall performance.
The competition between departments reduced team spirit.
Team spirit was high after winning the company award.

words.english_meaning: A person of lower rank or status who reports to a superior.
words.gujarati_meaning: Ochhu pad dhravta vayakti jo oocha adhikarine report kare.
words.usage_note: Good managers delegate effectively and treat subordinates with respect.
words.memory_tip: 'subordinate' = sub + ordinate → sub = neeche → subordinate = neeche wala.
examples: She manages five direct subordinates.
He treated his subordinates with great respect.
Good communication between manager and subordinate is essential.
Empower your subordinates by giving them responsibility.

words.english_meaning: The conduct, behaviour, and attitude expected of a professional person.
words.gujarati_meaning: Vyavsayik vayaktitha apekshit aacharan, vyavahar ane abhigam.
words.usage_note: Professionalism includes punctuality, proper communication, and meeting standards.
words.memory_tip: 'professionalism' = professional + ism → vayasayikta → professionalism = office ma sahi aacharan.
examples: She is known for her high level of professionalism.
Professionalism in the workplace builds trust and respect.
He handled the client complaint with great professionalism.
Always demonstrate professionalism in your emails.

words.english_meaning: A harmonious relationship with mutual trust and understanding.
words.gujarati_meaning: Parasparik vishvaas ane samajana saathe saras sambandha.
words.usage_note: Building rapport with clients and colleagues improves communication and outcomes.
words.memory_tip: 'rapport' = re + port → carry back → rapport = ek bija pase vaatoni aapali.
examples: She quickly built rapport with the new client.
Good rapport between manager and team boosts morale.
He has strong rapport with all departments.
Building rapport requires active listening and empathy.

words.english_meaning: The ability to understand and share the feelings of another person.
words.gujarati_meaning: Bija ni laagani samajva ane tena jeva anubhav karva ni kshamata.
words.usage_note: Leaders with empathy create more positive and inclusive workplaces.
words.memory_tip: 'empathy' = em + pathy → feel + inside → empathy = andar thi samajvanu.
examples: She showed empathy when a colleague was going through a tough time.
Empathy is a key leadership quality.
He handled the complaint with empathy and patience.
Workplace empathy builds stronger teams.

words.english_meaning: The fact or condition of being responsible for one's actions and decisions.
words.gujarati_meaning: Potana karyono ane nirnayoni jimmedari svikarva ni sthiti.
words.usage_note: Accountability means accepting responsibility when things go wrong, not just when they go right.
words.memory_tip: 'accountability' = account + ability → account = hisab → accountability = hisab aapva ni kshamata.
examples: She took full accountability for the project's failure.
Accountability is the foundation of trust in a team.
He refused to take accountability for the mistake.
A culture of accountability improves team performance.

words.english_meaning: A formal complaint made by an employee about a workplace issue.
words.gujarati_meaning: Karmachari dwara karyasthal na preshna ange karatee sattaavar farayad.
words.usage_note: All companies should have a formal grievance procedure for employees to raise concerns.
words.memory_tip: 'grievance' = grieve + ance → grieve = dukhi thavanu → grievance = dukh no sattavar avaaj.
examples: She filed a formal grievance about the manager's behaviour.
The HR team handles all employee grievances.
A grievance procedure ensures fair treatment.
He raised a grievance regarding unequal pay.

words.english_meaning: Aggressive, intimidating, or unwanted behaviour directed at someone in the workplace.
words.gujarati_meaning: Karyasthal ma koi prati avandhu, dabavtu athava agrahyo aacharan.
words.usage_note: Harassment is illegal in most countries; employees should report it to HR immediately.
words.memory_tip: 'harassment' = harry + ment → harry = tang karvanu → harassment = tang karva nu aacharan.
examples: She reported workplace harassment to the HR department.
Harassment of any kind is not tolerated in our company.
He faced legal consequences for workplace harassment.
All employees must complete anti-harassment training.

words.english_meaning: Including everyone, especially people from different backgrounds, without discrimination.
words.gujarati_meaning: Bhedabhav vagar badha ne, khaaskarake alag alag pachhapatna ne, saamil karvu.
words.usage_note: An inclusive workplace values diversity and ensures all voices are heard.
words.memory_tip: 'inclusive' = include + ive → include = samavesh → inclusive = badha ne samaviltu.
examples: The company promotes an inclusive workplace culture.
Inclusive policies attract diverse talent.
She ensured the meeting was inclusive of all team members.
An inclusive leader values every team member's opinion.

words.english_meaning: Working together with others to achieve a common goal.
words.gujarati_meaning: Ek samaan lakshya padhava mate bija saathe saath kaam karvu.
words.usage_note: Collaboration tools like Slack, Teams, and Notion facilitate remote team collaboration.
words.memory_tip: 'collaboration' = co + labor + ation → saath + mehnat → collaboration = saath mehnat.
examples: Collaboration between departments improved the project outcome.
She encouraged collaboration by sharing resources openly.
Effective collaboration requires trust and communication.
The new platform was designed for real-time collaboration.

words.english_meaning: Acknowledgement of someone's efforts, achievements, or contributions at work.
words.gujarati_meaning: Karyasthal ma koi ni mehnat, uplabdhi ya yogdaan ni kadra karvi.
words.usage_note: Employee recognition boosts morale, engagement, and retention.
words.memory_tip: 'recognition' = re + cognize → pharthi jaanvu → recognition = tamara kaami ni kadra.
examples: She received recognition for her contribution to the project.
Employee recognition programs improve motivation.
He gave public recognition to his team at the annual dinner.
Lack of recognition is a top reason employees leave jobs.

mini_dialogues.title: Discussing a Project Deadline
mini_dialogues.situation: Two colleagues discuss an approaching project deadline.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Hey, have you checked the project deadline? It's this Friday.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: I know. I've been trying to prioritize the key deliverables, but we still have a backlog.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Should we request a deadline extension from the manager?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Let's first see what can be done by tomorrow. We can clarify the situation with him in the morning briefing.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Good idea. I'll prepare a short summary of where we stand right now.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Perfect. Let's make sure we communicate clearly so there are no surprises.

mini_dialogues.title: Running a Team Meeting
mini_dialogues.situation: A manager facilitates a team meeting to discuss targets and action points.

turns.speaker: Manager
turns.text: Good morning everyone. Let's begin. I've shared the agenda by email — please take a look.

turns.speaker: Employee A
turns.text: I noticed the first agenda item is the quarterly targets. Are we on track?

turns.speaker: Manager
turns.text: Mostly yes, but we need to brainstorm ways to close the gap before month-end.

turns.speaker: Employee B
turns.text: I think the bottleneck is in the approval process. That's slowing us down.

turns.speaker: Manager
turns.text: Good point. Let's list that as an action point — we'll resolve it by Wednesday.

turns.speaker: Employee A
turns.text: Should I take the minutes so we have a clear record?

turns.speaker: Manager
turns.text: Yes please. Let's wrap up in twenty minutes so we can get back to work.

mini_dialogues.title: A Performance Appraisal Conversation
mini_dialogues.situation: A manager and employee discuss the employee's annual appraisal.

turns.speaker: Manager
turns.text: Thank you for coming in. Let's go through your performance review for this year.

turns.speaker: Employee
turns.text: Of course. I'm looking forward to your feedback.

turns.speaker: Manager
turns.text: Overall, your work has been excellent. You've met all your targets and shown great professionalism.

turns.speaker: Employee
turns.text: Thank you. I've worked hard on my time management this year.

turns.speaker: Manager
turns.text: It shows. Based on your appraisal, we're recommending you for a promotion.

turns.speaker: Employee
turns.text: That's wonderful news. I'm grateful for the recognition and the opportunity.

mini_dialogues.title: Handling a Workplace Conflict
mini_dialogues.situation: HR facilitates conflict resolution between two colleagues.

turns.speaker: HR
turns.text: I understand there's been some tension between you two. Let's try to resolve this professionally.

turns.speaker: Employee A
turns.text: I raised a grievance because I felt my colleague was taking credit for my work.

turns.speaker: Employee B
turns.text: That wasn't my intention at all. I should have acknowledged your contribution in the report.

turns.speaker: HR
turns.text: Thank you for being open. Accountability is key here. Can you both agree on how to collaborate better going forward?

turns.speaker: Employee A
turns.text: Yes. I'd appreciate more clear communication and recognition when I contribute.

turns.speaker: Employee B
turns.text: Agreed. I'll make sure to acknowledge everyone's efforts in future reports.

mini_dialogues.title: Preparing for a Client Presentation
mini_dialogues.situation: Two colleagues prepare a slide deck and rehearse for a client presentation.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Is the slide deck ready for tomorrow's presentation?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Almost. I just need to add the Q3 figures and a summary slide at the end.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Make sure you summarize the key findings clearly. The client wants to reach a consensus on the proposal quickly.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Understood. I'll also prepare a few talking points for the Q&A session.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Good. Don't forget to connect the laptop to the projector before they arrive.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Already booked the conference room and checked the projector. We're all set.
